# phasetwo_regions (Data Source)

Regions a new dedicated cluster can be provisioned into.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "phasetwo_regions" "available" {}

output "regions" {
  value = data.phasetwo_regions.available.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) Region names, e.g. `US_EAST_1`.
